Castle redraws exact built-in CICN 128 when persistent Search is switched off. Rebuilt retains it as source-proven control-state evidence; the visible command uses the licensed transparent Searching animation instead of importing the old gray control plate.

Castle updatecontrols draws exact application PICT 180 in the ordinary exploration Encounter slot. Rebuilt samples only its yin-yang disc and recomposes the live Encounter caption on application slate.
Castle updatecontrols draws exact application PICT 225 whenever a Shop is available. Rebuilt samples only its shop mark and recomposes the live Shop caption on application slate.

The licensed non-commercial Realmz effect atlas supplies the eight-frame Searching animation at row y=128. Presentation removes only its six legacy neutral-gray matte keys at runtime; the cataloged bytes remain unchanged. Castle CICN 128 remains separately cataloged as the source-proven inactive Search control image.
